description:
iCOMPLY contract: explain a prediction in features + narrative.

Returns the Glicko-2 μ/φ inputs for both entities + a deterministic
narrative. No LLM-synthesised rationale — these are the actual
numbers the math uses, which is exactly what an Annex IV auditor
needs to trace.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_explain
